note: Read from the vendored file at the digest above, the whole 302,172 bytes. Elements are grouped by the design's regions in template order: titlebar, drawer, fleet, audit, settings, thread notices, launcher, conversation, composer, dock, handoff, fullscreen preview, palette. `where` and `states` are for the human reading the design; the gate holds copy and evidence only. Sample data is the fictional session (acme-api, the Stripe webhook task, mac-mini-m4 and friends) and is claimed under `sample` with no element.
sample: writes a file on this machine · 1,204 rows match
Lost the daemon on wsl-ubuntu-24, last heard 41s ago
Webhooks get delivered twice when Stripe retries. Fix it properly, tests included.
FAIL webhooks/replay.spec.ts › retries the same event twice
→ the assertion encodes the bug; rewritten in step 4
You asked for this command from the composer. It is still gated, because no rule covers prisma migrate on this machine yet.
step 3 of 4 · refused by the daemon
The agent read PROD_DATABASE_URL and aimed at production. A rule forbids it, so the daemon refused before the command ran. No approval or mode can permit this.
Your edit to step 4 is queued. It applies at the next turn boundary, not to the turn in flight.
One row per Stripe event id. The unique key is the claim, so a second delivery cannot insert.
